dedupe_keys.name: hbefa handbook emission factors for road transport

description: The Handbook Emission Factors for Road Transport (HBEFA) provides emission factors for all current vehicle categories: passenger cars, light duty vehicles, heavy goods vehicles, urban buses, coaches and motorcycles, each split into sub-categories, for a wide variety of traffic situations. It is a joint product of funding agencies and development partners in six countries. Coverage: all regulated and the main non-regulated pollutants, fuel and energy consumption and CO2, with country-specific fleet scenarios (the September 2026 update 5.1.009 corrects, for example, Swedish and Swiss defaults and adds N2O and NH3 factors for the heaviest trucks based on COPERT). Format and access: HBEFA 5.x is a Python-based client-server application with a Windows desktop client that runs from an unzipped archive; a detailed version offers more differentiated factors and queries. Licence and cost: an internal-use licence is bought through an order form, and a commercial licence allows reproduction and integration in third-party tools. Caveats: factors are tied to traffic-situation classes, so link-level use needs mapping from model outputs. The factors let traffic simulations and network flow models produce emissions and energy use. It relates to COPERT in the catalogue.
